text: It's a great app. It's free. It doesn't have any pay for ads or premium for unlimited habits, or anything at all like that. It's completely free. It works offline too, but you can still sync it with your Google account when you go online. The sloth icon is kinda cool, because that would be me and you and all of us, otherwise you wouldn't be finding a good habit app in the first place. Anyway, as picky as I am, I think this app is good. It doesn't have a measurable habit feature or notes tho
author: Rhimar Ibañez

text: So far I like this app. One issue I would like to see changed: when I have already checked off a habit for the day (before the reminder), could you have it then cancel the scheduled reminder for that item? I often check off several habits at once, & having all those notifications come up for each one *after* already completed is a bit annoying. Thanks.
author: Cari Cruse
developer_reply: Thanks for your thoughtful feedback! Great point about reminders after a habit is already completed. We agree this should be smarter. We’ve added this suggestion to the improvement list.
